question: Does the sign-up form at login.sia.storage ask for anything beyond an email address, such as a name, a phone number or a card?
why: the email login page is captured and the sign-up link is on it, but login.sia.storage/u/signup/identifier answers HTTP 400 without the state parameter the login flow issues, so the fields of the sign-up form itself are unverified; identity_cost.kind is email on the login page alone.
